limitations: Local evidence register, not authenticated payment verification; native provider retrieval and genuine customer confirmation must be recorded independently.
Retained requests include tests and a bounded first page; only explicitly qualified external requests enter this cohort.
No backfill of work time. Recorded time is partial until coverage is explicitly reconciled, including refusals, support and overhead. Automation elapsed time is not human labor or a cash model bill.
The hourly valuation is an assumption. Contribution stays unknown without human and actual fee/cost coverage.
Public GET events include bots/repeats and cannot supply a unique or qualified visitor denominator. Ten requests are a decision checkpoint, not proof of market fit.
Assisted native email requires a present authorized operator, reconciled event receipts and current capacity. It does not repair automatic Site sending or prove a paid report was received.
